name: Turkish Poker
description: Türk pokeri (Turkish Poker) is a five-card draw variant played with a short deck of 24 to 36 cards depending on player count. Each player receives five cards; up to four may be exchanged in the draw. Opening requires a pair of Kings; hand rankings differ from international poker (flush beats full house, three of a kind beats straight).

content.text: Türk pokeri (Turkish Poker) is a five-card draw variant played with a short deck of 24 to 36 cards depending on player count. Each player receives five cards; up to four may be exchanged in the draw. Opening requires a pair of Kings; hand rankings differ from international poker (flush beats full house, three of a kind beats straight).

Turkish poker (Türk pokeri) is a draw poker variant using a shortened French deck; information is attributed to Burçin Kerem Seyis. It follows the same deal–bet–draw–bet–showdown structure as five-card draw but with a minimum opening requirement of a pair of Kings and distinct hand rankings.
Short deck: 24 cards (2 players) through 36 cards (5 players), made by removing low cards from a standard 52-card pack.
First dealer chosen at random; deal rotates left. Before each deal all players ante an equal amount. Cards are shuffled, cut, and dealt clockwise one at a time until each player has five cards.
